mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate directly lowers discount rates in equity valuation models, compressing the cost of capital and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.25% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 235.5 signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 235.5 fails to predict negative 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
